notes: Exploratory diagnosis on a fixed test split; original reported protocol and results are preserved.
Per-user EER uses test-fitted local thresholds as a diagnostic, not a calibrated deployable improvement.
Reference alternatives and interventions must not be used for post-hoc best-reference or seed selection.
More-steps treatment keeps 20 epochs and decay per epoch; it changes both update count and decay timing in optimizer steps.
DeepAirSig triplets overlap; their empirical distribution is descriptive, not independent trials or a p-value.
runner_revision_note: Published runner corrects only a progress dataset label after the experiment; executed source with recorded SHA-256 is retained in private evidence.
